band-rule.note: Kit Paper at 22% alpha over the band; the ramp is Kit Paper's hue.

display-band.purpose: The Solo Ship Kit title on the green band; the largest type on the page.

headline.purpose: Project entry titles (Direction, Vitaly, the washer) and Contact.

headline-sm.purpose: The lighter entries: Coursework and About.

title.purpose: Archivo 700 at 108-112% width: headings inside an entry, mobile menu links, FSM readout values.

lede.purpose: The one sentence under each entry title and the kit subtitle.

body-lg.purpose: Hero intro, About paragraphs, the contact line.

label.purpose: Sentence-case muted headings over lists (Latest in the log, Stack, Discord commands).

mono.purpose: Versions, dates, statuses, state and system names, numbers, commands. Ligatures off, tabular figures.

shadows.name: ambient-dark
shadows.purpose: The open mobile section menu and the phone screenshots, dark theme (--shadow).

shadows.name: ambient-light
shadows.purpose: The same roles in the light theme (--shadow).

shadows.name: spine-node-knockout
shadows.purpose: An unlit 18px spine node: a track-colored ring, cut out of the spine by a ring of ground color. Shape, not elevation.

shadows.name: fsm-node-knockout
shadows.purpose: An unlit 16px FSM stage node on its rail.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: The border of secondary buttons, the copy button and stack chips, drawn inside so it never changes the box size.

shadows.name: band-hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: The secondary button's ring on the kit-green band.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: The one custom curve, on every transform (--ease-out-quint). Opacity fades use plain ease.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 400ms ease-out-quint; opacity 0 -> 1, translateY(16px) -> 0 (headline lines 0.3em); staggered by --d
motion.purpose: Load entrance for what is on screen at load only: hero lines, hero copy, log index, the kit band header. Runs in CSS so it plays from prerendered HTML.

motion.name: spine-draw
motion.purpose: The spine draws down on load.

motion.name: spine-fill
motion.value: scroll-linked scaleY; head on a reading line at 60% of the viewport, moving to 100% as the page ends
motion.purpose: The spine fills with the scroll so the ledger is full at the footer. Transform only.

motion.name: node-light
motion.purpose: A spine node lights once the 60% reading line passes it. This is a section's only arrival; sections never fade.

motion.name: stagger
motion.value: opacity 360ms ease, translateY(16px) -> 0 360ms ease-out-quint, 50ms per item
motion.purpose: Screenshots, the nine-step loop and course rows. Armed only when the list starts below the fold after load.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback on buttons, program controls and the copy button.

motion.name: link-press-dim
motion.purpose: Press feedback on links that are not buttons (wordmark, nav, menu, log index rows, text links). The one value under 150ms, because press feedback must feel instant.

motion.name: hover-overlay
motion.purpose: Button hover tint on fine pointers; only opacity animates.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Arrows move toward their destination on hover.

motion.name: value-in
motion.purpose: A changed FSM readout value settles into place.

motion.name: fsm-step
motion.value: 200ms per stage, rail fill transform 200ms linear
motion.purpose: The FSM run steps along its own rail; linear because it follows the machine's clock.

motion.name: menu-enter
motion.purpose: The mobile section menu drops in under the header.

motion.name: icon-swap
motion.value: opacity 200ms ease, rotate(-60deg) scale(0.6) -> none 300ms ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Theme toggle icons; the copy button swaps icon and label (160/220ms, 150/200ms) in one grid cell.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Switching theme crossfades the page; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transitions 0.01ms; rise -> 200ms fade; spine-draw none; value-in -> fade; FSM jumps to done; no theme crossfade; no smooth scroll
motion.purpose: Reduced motion means fades or nothing.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.note: The CV link joins the header bar.

breakpoints.name: index-compact
breakpoints.note: Below it the log index's date column narrows to 4.75rem.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Spine 4px at and below; FSM programs five across and readout four across from it; full wordmark from it.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.note: Full nav replaces the Menu button; screenshots cap at phone size instead of 46% width.

breakpoints.name: flow
breakpoints.note: Vitaly flow diagram goes horizontal; course rows split into two columns.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Two-column 7fr/5fr grids; the FSM rail goes horizontal across eight columns.

narrative.overview:
The page is the release ledger of someone who ships. A thick green spine, carried over from the left rule in Solo Ship Kit's marketing images, runs down the whole page, and every project hangs off it as an entry: a wide, heavy Archivo title with a node on the spine, then a monospaced line with its version, date and a true status. Filled nodes are things that shipped; hollow nodes are the rest. The ledger is the structure. There are no project cards.

Density is that of a well-kept log: generous air between entries, tight ruled lists inside them, and facts set as label and value rows with the numbers in tabular mono. Surfaces are flat and separated by tone and 1px rules. Green is scarce and always means something: shipped status, the spine, the primary action. The one exception is the product itself: Solo Ship Kit sits on a full-bleed kit-green band in both themes, and inside it the system inverts to paper. Dark ground is the default (the kit's ink deepened); the light theme is the kit's paper, with identical structure.

Motion is one authored moment. The spine draws in on load, then fills with the scroll as a reading line 60% down the viewport passes each title and lights its node. Sections never fade in on their own; the node lighting is their arrival. Everything else is small and quick: presses scale, arrows nudge, changed values settle. The world rejects glass, gradient blobs, neon glow and tracked-uppercase mono kickers, and it refuses the category default of a big name over a gradient followed by a grid of equal project cards.
keyCharacteristics: A continuous green spine with circular nodes: filled for what shipped, hollow for the rest.
Archivo at 118% width and weight 800 as the only display voice; Inter for reading; JetBrains Mono for data.
Flat, tonal surfaces and 1px rules; one ambient shadow, only for what floats.
Green as signal, never decoration; a full-bleed kit-green band for the product alone.
Motion on transform and opacity only, 150–400ms, on one custom ease-out curve.
Dark by default, a paper light theme, the same structure in both.

rules.name: The Shipped-Green Rule
rules.body: Green marks shipped or verified status, the spine and its nodes, primary buttons and the selected FSM program. It is never decoration: no green headings, icons, borders, washes or hover tints anywhere else.

rules.name: The Mint-on-Dark Rule
rules.body: Green text on the night ground is Kit Mint, never Kit Green, which fails at 2.98:1; the spine on dark is Spine Green. In the light theme Kit Green does all three jobs.

rules.name: The One Band Rule
rules.body: The full-bleed kit-green band belongs to Solo Ship Kit alone and stays green in both themes. Inside it the system inverts: the spine and filled nodes turn paper and the spine loses its rounded ends, the primary button is paper with deep-green text, secondary text is Band Mint, and the focus ring is paper.

rules.name: The Trimmed Axis Rule
rules.body: The fonts are self-hosted and trimmed to the axis ranges the page uses: Archivo weight 700–800 and width 106–118%, Inter and JetBrains Mono weight 400–700. A weight or width outside those ranges needs the woff2 files re-trimmed first; never let the browser synthesize it.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono sets only versions, dates, numbers, statuses, state and system names, and code, always with ligatures off and tabular figures. It never sets prose or headings, and never appears as a tracked-uppercase kicker.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading and label is sentence case at its natural tracking. Nothing on the page is uppercase, and no label sits above a heading.

rules.name: The Spine Rule
rules.body: Every section's content sits right of the spine, indented by the spine's width plus the spine gap, and every entry title carries a node on the spine centred on its first line. Nothing sits between the gutter and the spine.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: Lists and facts are rows between 1px rules, not boxes. Facts read label left in muted text and value right at 600, in mono when the value holds a digit. Feature and contents lists mark items with a short 2px dash.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The ambient shadow means something floats above the page (a menu, a phone); buttons, chips, flow nodes, program controls and spine nodes never take it.

rules.name: The Circle Means Stage Rule
rules.body: Circles are reserved for points on a timeline: spine nodes (18px), FSM stage nodes (16px) and the status dot (0.5rem). No circular avatars, icon buttons or badges.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Outside Rule
rules.body: A dashed outline marks something outside the system or not run: the external API in the flow diagram (1px) and a stage the chosen program skips (2px).

rules.name: The Reading Line Rule
rules.body: A section arrives when its spine node lights at the 60% reading line. Sections never fade or slide in on their own. Only what is on screen at load plays an entrance: the hero copy, the log index and the kit band's header rise 16px into place, and the headline lines rise 0.3em (400ms, staggered by delay).

rules.name: The Rail Echo Rule
rules.body: A sequence that runs is drawn in the spine's own vocabulary: a track, a green fill, and filled, ringed or dashed nodes.

dos: **Do** give every entry a true status in its mono meta line, with a filled node for what shipped and a hollow node for the rest.
**Do** use Kit Mint (#7fd8b3) for green text on the night ground and Spine Green (#12855f) for the spine there; in the light theme Kit Green (#0b6e4f) does both.
**Do** separate with tone and 1px rules: tags, chips, flow nodes and program controls take the surface tone; lists and facts are rows between rules.
**Do** animate only transform and opacity, 150–400ms, with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) on transforms and plain ease on opacity; the press dim on text links is the one faster value (120ms).
**Do** keep hover effects behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine), and give every control a press state: scale(0.97) for buttons, a 60% dim for links.

**Do** theme the browser's own surfaces: Kit Green text selection with white text, a 2px focus outline at 3px offset in Kit Mint on dark, Kit Green on light and paper on the band, a Rule Strong scrollbar over the ground, and underlines at 0.22em offset.

**Do** honour reduced motion with fades or nothing: entrances become a 200ms fade, the spine appears already drawn, transitions collapse, the FSM jumps to its finished state and the theme switches without a crossfade.
**Do** cap reading measure at 38–44rem and balance headings.
donts: **Don't** use green as decoration: no green headings, icons, borders, washes or hover tints outside status, the spine and its nodes, primary buttons and the selected program.
**Don't** set Kit Green text on the night ground; it fails at 2.98:1.
**Don't** lay projects out as a grid of equal cards, or open with a big name over a gradient.
**Don't** use glass, gradient blobs, neon glow or tracked-uppercase mono kickers, and don't put an eyebrow label above any heading.
**Don't** give list items, callouts or panels a colored side stripe; the only thick vertical green rule is the spine.
**Don't** fade or slide whole sections in, and don't arm a staggered list that is already on screen at load.
**Don't** animate width, height, position, color or background, or run any single motion longer than 400ms.
**Don't** set Archivo outside weight 700–800 or width 106–118%, or Inter and JetBrains Mono outside weight 400–700, without re-trimming the fonts.
**Don't** add the ambient shadow to buttons, chips, flow nodes, program controls or nodes.
